name: S3 Browser
description: S3-compatible object storage plugin for DBX.

contributions.label: S3 connection
contributions.description: Connect to AWS S3 or an S3-compatible object storage service.

fields.label: Endpoint protocol
fields.description: Keep HTTPS unless the storage only speaks plain HTTP, such as an on-premises MinIO on a trusted network.

fields.label: Endpoint host
fields.description: Host name only — no https:// prefix and no path. Examples: Aliyun OSS oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com; Tencent COS cos.ap-guangzhou.myqcloud.com; AWS s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com; MinIO 192.168.1.10:9000.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: AWS region such as us-east-1. Leave empty for Aliyun OSS, Tencent COS, and MinIO — the region is already part of their endpoints; empty falls back to us-east-1.

fields.label: Base path
fields.description: Object prefix mapped to the DBX filesystem root; / uses the whole bucket, for example /project/assets.

fields.label: Addressing style
fields.description: Virtual-hosted puts the bucket into the hostname (the style Aliyun OSS and Tencent COS expect); path-style keeps it in the URL path (typical for MinIO and on-premises gateways). Automatic picks per provider.

fields.label: AWS dual-stack endpoints
fields.description: Opt in to AWS IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack endpoints. Disabled by default to avoid rewriting standard AWS endpoints; has no effect on other S3-compatible services.

fields.label: Bucket
fields.description: Optional. Set a bucket name to scope this connection to that single bucket; leave empty to browse every bucket the credentials can access after connecting.

fields.label: Session token
fields.description: Optional temporary credential token for STS or IAM roles.

contributions.label: S3 Browser
contributions.description: Browse and manage S3 objects in a custom workbench.

zh-CN.name: S3 Browser
zh-CN.description: S3 兼容对象存储插件。

io.github.t8y2.s3.connection.label: S3 连接
io.github.t8y2.s3.connection.description: 连接 AWS S3 或 S3 兼容对象存储服务。

endpoint_protocol.label: 端点协议
endpoint_protocol.description: 内网或自建明文环境（如未配置证书的 MinIO）选择 HTTP，其余保持 HTTPS。

endpoint.label: 端点主机
endpoint.description: 只填主机名（Endpoint），不带 https://、不带路径。示例：阿里云 OSS 填 oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com；腾讯云 COS 填 cos.ap-guangzhou.myqcloud.com；AWS 填 s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com；MinIO/自建填 192.168.1.10:9000。

region.label: 区域
region.description: AWS 需填写 Region，如 us-east-1；阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS、MinIO 可留空（区域已包含在端点中），留空时默认 us-east-1。

base_path.label: 基础路径
base_path.description: 映射为文件系统根的对象前缀；/ 表示整个存储桶，例如 /project/assets。

addressing_style.label: 寻址方式
addressing_style.description: MinIO 等自建服务建议选择 Path-style；阿里云 OSS、腾讯云 COS 建议选择 Virtual-hosted；不确定就保持自动。

aws_dualstack.label: AWS 双栈端点
aws_dualstack.description: 启用 AWS IPv4/IPv6 双栈端点。默认关闭，避免将标准 AWS 端点改写为 dualstack；不影响其他 S3 兼容服务。

bucket.label: 存储桶
bucket.description: 可选。填写桶名则本连接只管理该桶；留空则连接后列出凭据可见的所有桶，再进入具体桶浏览。

session_token.label: 会话令牌
session_token.description: STS 或临时 IAM 凭据的可选令牌（Session Token）。

io.github.t8y2.s3.workbench.label: S3 Browser
io.github.t8y2.s3.workbench.description: 在自定义工作台中浏览和管理 S3 对象。
